title: Cline gets an adapter from its published CLI reference
name: cline-host
description: The ADR 0052 method, for Cline: read the published Cline CLI reference (the npm `cline` package, its headless/non-interactive flags, its JSON output format, its auth check) and write the adapter from that — never from memory, and every flag cited with the doc it came from in the adapter's comment. Add `cline` to `ADAPTERS` in packages/core/src/hosts.ts: `probe` (whatever reports auth without a task), `signIn`, `loggedIn`, `argv` (headless, auto-approve, JSON events, `NO_HUMAN` in front of the brief like Codex/OpenCode/Cursor since it has no system-prompt flag), `attendable: false`, `line` for its event shapes. Recordings of the real CLI output go in docs/testing/v1x-4-other-hosts.tdd.md next to the other hosts. `Candidate.host` in models.ts gains `'cline'` only if Cline exposes a model list a command can read; otherwise leave `sober models` alone and say so in the ADR. Write docs/adr/0063-cline-gets-an-adapter-from-a-published-reference.md. README per-host install section gets a `cline` block; the `.sober/config.jsonc` comment above `dispatch.host` names it. A Cline *plugin* (MCP config + skills in a packages/cline-plugin, so a person can drive the board from inside Cline) is not this node — open it later if wanted. Tests: hosts.test.ts argv and line cases from the recordings.
